title: SPK-* items
summary: Spokes family covering 13G and 14G wheel-building spokes across various lengths, tracked in stock and purchase records.
body:
The `SPK-*` item family encompasses bicycle spokes used across Northbridge Cycles wheel assemblies, categorized primarily into 13-gauge and 14-gauge variants in multiple lengths [^r1][^r8][^r11]. Stock balances are primarily held in the central Manchester store WH-MAN-STR, with small quantities of select lines maintained at the Leeds facility WH-LDS-STR [^r2][^r4]. As of 26 October 2026, stock-on-hand levels and open purchase commitments are recorded across the active part numbers [^r1][^r6][^r9].

## Stock and procurement

Stock records in [[data-stock-on-hand]] at 09:00 on 26 October 2026 reflect the following balances across warehouse facilities:

### 14-gauge spokes (SPK-14G)
* **SPK-14G-254**: WH-MAN-STR holds 17,600 on hand, 2,185 allocated, and 9,000 on order [^r1].
* **SPK-14G-256**: WH-MAN-STR holds 2,090 on hand and 348 allocated [^r1].
* **SPK-14G-258**: WH-MAN-STR holds 10 on hand (2 allocated), while WH-LDS-STR holds 5 on hand (0 allocated) [^r2].
* **SPK-14G-260**: WH-MAN-STR holds 11 on hand and 1 allocated [^r2].
* **SPK-14G-262**: WH-MAN-STR holds 2,043 on hand and 479 allocated [^r3].
* **SPK-14G-264**: WH-MAN-STR holds 863 on hand and 419 allocated [^r3].
* **SPK-14G-266**: WH-MAN-STR holds 18 on hand (0 allocated, 10 on order), while WH-LDS-STR holds 7 on hand (0 allocated) [^r4].
* **SPK-14G-268**: WH-MAN-STR holds 1,152 on hand and 88 allocated [^r5].
* **SPK-14G-270**: WH-MAN-STR holds 5,299 on hand and 273 allocated [^r5].
* **SPK-14G-272**: WH-MAN-STR holds 4,409 on hand and 211 allocated [^r5].
* **SPK-14G-274**: WH-MAN-STR holds 6,719 on hand, 20 allocated, and 2,000 on order [^r6].
* **SPK-14G-276**: WH-MAN-STR holds 24,718 on hand, 1,709 allocated, and 9,000 on order [^r6].
* **SPK-14G-278**: WH-MAN-STR holds 29,126 on hand and 764 allocated [^r7].
* **SPK-14G-288**: WH-MAN-STR holds 30,032 on hand and 22 allocated [^r7].

### 13-gauge spokes (SPK-13G)
* **SPK-13G-254**: WH-MAN-STR holds 5,550 on hand, 115 allocated, and 2,000 on order [^r9].
* **SPK-13G-266**: WH-MAN-STR holds 34,693 on hand, 833 allocated, and 0 on order [^r8].
* **SPK-13G-274**: Spoke item SPK-13G-274 was ordered under PO/2026/00125 on 2026-01-30 in a quantity of 18,000 NOS at £0.37 per unit from supplier HW-STO-1106 [^r11].
* **SPK-13G-288**: WH-MAN-STR holds 7,338 on hand, 520 allocated, and 2,000 on order [^r9].
* **SPK-13G-298**: WH-MAN-STR holds 17,007 on hand, 667 allocated, and 9,000 on order [^r10].
